# Treanor Digital

> Principal-led AI implementation, digital marketing, native iOS mobile app development, and technology consulting for startups and growing businesses. Based in Monroe, Michigan. Founded and led by Kevin Treanor with 20+ years of senior agency and engineering experience.

## Core Services

- [AI Strategy & Implementation](https://treanordigital.com/#services): AI opportunity and workflow audits, custom Claude and LLM tools, NLP sentiment and competitive intelligence pipelines, process automation, and team enablement.
- [Digital Marketing & Brand Intelligence](https://treanordigital.com/#services): Web strategy, UX, SEO, AEO, and GEO (AI search visibility), paid acquisition, email lifecycle, executive analytics dashboards, and competitive benchmarking.
- [Mobile App Development](https://treanordigital.com/#services): Native iOS Swift and SwiftUI application engineering, StoreKit 2 monetization, offline-first data architecture, and App Store launch delivery.
- [Web & Technology Consulting](https://treanordigital.com/#services): Custom websites and web applications, Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), marketing stack integrations, LMS setup, and technical team leadership.

## Engagement Models

- [Free Initial Analysis Report](https://treanordigital.com/#how-we-work): Complimentary, no-obligation Website Review (design, content, voice, and SEO) or deep-dive SEO, AEO, and GEO standing report.
- [Focused Build Sprint](https://treanordigital.com/#how-we-work): Fixed-scope delivery for native apps, AI workflows, executive dashboards, or web builds.
- [Fractional Senior Partner](https://treanordigital.com/#how-we-work): Ongoing embedded senior digital and technical leadership with no long-term lock-in.

## Published Mobile Applications

- [ASE A-Series Certification Prep (iOS)](https://treanordigital.com/apps/ase-prep/): Native SwiftUI iOS study suite for automotive technicians preparing for ASE A1 through A9 certification exams, with Prometric-accurate timed mock exams, offline shop references, and StoreKit 2 one-time unlocks.
- [ASE Prep App Support & FAQ](https://treanordigital.com/apps/ase-prep/#support): Direct developer support and StoreKit purchase restoration guidance.

## Perspectives

- [Perspectives Index](https://treanordigital.com/perspectives/): Practical field notes and frameworks by Kevin Treanor.
- [Two Ways Small Businesses Should Actually Use AI](https://treanordigital.com/perspectives/small-business-ai-strategy/): Strategic framework distinguishing AI augmentation of core craft from AI automation of operational overhead.
